subject: Who texts the lead back first usually wins
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Confession: most service businesses don't lose a lead to a better competitor.


They lose them to whoever answered first.


This one's really for businesses juggling client work and inbound leads at the same time.


A DM comes in while you're mid-session.


It waits until you're free.


By then the lead's already messaged two other options.


If every inquiry you get already gets an instant reply, this one's not for you — skip ahead.


The old way: check your phone between appointments, reply when you remember.


The AI Growth Engine's way: every DM, form fill, and missed call gets a response in seconds — nobody has to be watching a phone for it to happen.


One independent service business we looked at ran this exact test.


Same leads. Same offer.


The only thing that changed was speed — an automated reply the moment someone reached out, instead of waiting until end of day.


More of those leads turned into booked calls, simply because they were still warm when they got a response.

Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth
